privateVars.name: syncStates
privateVars.description: In-memory map tracking last sync time and interval per account

privateVars.name: prisma
privateVars.description: Prisma database service for account and message queries

privateVars.name: gateway
privateVars.description: WebSocket gateway for real-time email and notification events

functions.name: handleSyncCron
functions.description: Cron job (every minute) that checks all email accounts and triggers background syncs based on jittered intervals (5-10 min)

functions.name: syncAccount
functions.description: Syncs a single email account via IMAP: connects, iterates folders, fetches new UIDs, parses messages with E2EE, caches metadata/body/attachments, and emits email:new/notification:created events

functions.name: getStandardFolderName
functions.description: Maps IMAP folder objects to standard folder names (inbox, sent, drafts, trash, junk, archive)
